title: Aggregate Payments per Day
learning_objective: Learn how to reduce multiple customer rows into one daily total.

tutorial.explanation: Moving average problems usually start by creating a daily grain. If multiple payments happen on the same date, sum them first.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM customer GROUP BY visited_on;
tutorial.mental_model: Before a moving window can slide over days, each day needs one total amount.

guided_example.solution_query: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM customer GROUP BY visited_on;
guided_example.explanation: GROUP BY visited_on creates one row per day.

practice.prompt: Return visited_on and total amount for each day.
practice.expected_query: SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM customer GROUP BY visited_on;
